Groundwork for group chats that keep running on the VM. Nothing changes for your groups yet: they still run in the app.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.11.exe`** below and run it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** If you download the installer in a browser, Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. The one-command install doesn't get that prompt.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Changes

- **Runner-owned groups (preview, for operators).** A group can be marked to run on a VM runner. The runner answers it, and the app stays silent in it. Groups without the mark run exactly as before.
- **No double replies.** The app only answers the groups it owns, so a runner group is never answered twice.
- **Older versions don't know the mark.** Install 1.8.11 on every computer that opens a runner group. Versions 1.8.10 and earlier would still answer those groups while open.
